As an Assembly Technician, you will work on advanced electromechanical systems within an innovative high-tech production environment. You will join an international organization where technology, quality, and collaboration are at the heart of everything. Together with your colleagues, you will assemble modules and systems that are used worldwide in advanced technological applications. What’s your job about? As an Assembly Technician, you will be responsible for assembling complex technical systems and modules. You ensure that products are built accurately according to technical drawings, specifications, and work instructions. Your responsibilities include: Assembling mechanical and electromechanical modules and systems. Working according to technical drawings, schematics, and assembly instructions. Building cabinets, subassemblies, and technical components. Performing measurements and quality inspections. Identifying deviations and contributing to process improvements. Collaborating with colleagues from production, engineering, and quality departments. Ensuring products meet the highest quality standards. You will work in a two-shift schedule: Morning shift: 06:00 – 14:15 Afternoon shift: 14:15 – 23:00 (Friday: until 20:30) What skills do you have? We are looking for a motivated technician with an eye for detail and an interest in high-tech manufacturing. Affinity with technology, assembly, or production. A proactive and hands-on attitude. Sense of responsibility and ownership. Good communication skills in English. What do you get in return? A position within an innovative high-tech organization. A modern and professional working environment. An international and collaborative team culture. Competitive employment conditions. You will join a leading high-tech manufacturing organization in the Eindhoven region. The company develops and produces advanced technological systems and modules that are used worldwide in industries such as semiconductors, healthcare, industrial automation, and mobility. Innovation, quality, and continuous improvement are central to the organization. Employees are encouraged to take initiative, develop their technical skills, and build a long-term career within a dynamic international environment.
